name: game-juice
description: Evergreen skills that study a game's codebase and suggest juice: screen shake, hit-stop, squash and stretch, easing, camera kick, layered and pitch-varied sound, responsive UI, haptics, coyote time and input buffering. juice-scan maps the feel moments and writes a prioritized report with file, function, cited principle, parameters and an engine code sketch; juice-apply implements a chosen suggestion behind toggles with accessibility options; juice-principles holds the medium-independent knowledge base and Schell-style lenses. Unity, Godot, Roblox, Phaser/PixiJS/GSAP and Pygame.
